verdict.rationale: Angular's first-party materials point to a dedicated upgrade guide, which the CLI's `ng update` docs also reference as the Update Guide. The evidence only links to the guide and says nothing about its content, so how well it handles moves between incompatible major versions is unproven. missing for 10: evidence of the guide's version-to-version migration steps and coverage of breaking changes, independent or hands-on corroboration that developers can follow it successfully.

support.subject: As a developer, I can follow a dedicated migration guide when moving between two incompatible major versions of the framework

citations.quote: Check out our upgrade guide to find out the best way to upgrade your project.
Updates your workspace and its dependencies. See the Update Guide.
